classification.difficultyReason: Construct and label graphs without supplied options, coordinating starting values, direction and changing steepness; the baby’s weight requires a positive minimum followed by increasingly rapid growth.

content.prompt: Draw graphs to illustrate these scenarios. Label the axes.

children.label: a
children.prompt: The price of an object used to be free, rose quickly at first, and is now rising at a decreasing rate.

answer.short: An increasing curve from the origin that becomes less steep; horizontal axis Time, vertical axis Price.
answer.worked: Free means the initial price is zero. A rapid initial rise gives a steep positive gradient. As the rate of increase decreases, the curve continues upwards but becomes less steep.

spec.description: Arrowed, unscaled axes; increasing concave-down curve begins at the origin. Source orange curve is standardised to house blue; ordinary axes and labels are black.
spec.mathematics: Zero initial price; positive gradient decreasing over time. Coordinates are qualitative drawing coordinates, not numerical data.

children.label: b
children.prompt: The temperature of a cup of coffee decreases quickly at first and then more slowly until it reaches room temperature.

answer.short: A decreasing curve that flattens towards a dashed room-temperature line above zero; horizontal axis Time, vertical axis Temperature.
answer.worked: Start above room temperature. The temperature falls rapidly at first, so the curve initially slopes steeply downwards. It becomes less steep as the coffee cools and levels towards room temperature.

spec.description: Decreasing curve approaches a dashed horizontal line labelled Room temperature above the time axis. Source blue axes become black; curve and reference use standard blue.
spec.mathematics: Positive temperature decreases at a decreasing rate towards a positive room-temperature level; no numerical scale.

children.label: c
children.prompt: The level of pollution in the atmosphere of a city starts low and is increasing at an increasing rate.

answer.short: An increasing curve starting low above zero and becoming steeper; horizontal axis Time, vertical axis Pollution.
answer.worked: Start with a low positive pollution level. Increasing pollution gives an upward curve. An increasing rate of increase means its positive gradient becomes larger over time.

spec.description: Arrowed axes without ticks; low positive intercept and increasingly steep rising curve. Black axes and standard blue curve.
spec.mathematics: Positive initial pollution; increasing quantity and increasing positive gradient.

children.label: d
children.prompt: The population of a town increased rapidly when a new factory opened and then it remained steady.

answer.short: A rising curve from a positive population, with a steep section followed by a horizontal plateau; horizontal axis Time, vertical axis Population.
answer.worked: A rapid population increase is shown by a steep upward section. Once the population remains steady, the gradient is zero, so the graph continues horizontally.

spec.description: Positive initial population; rising curve steepens, bends smoothly into a plateau and then stays horizontal. No numerical scale.
spec.mathematics: Population increases rapidly before becoming constant.

children.label: e
children.prompt: The weight of a baby decreased slightly after its birth and then increased at an increasing rate.

answer.short: A curve starting above zero, dipping slightly to a positive minimum and then rising increasingly steeply; horizontal axis Time, vertical axis Weight.
answer.worked: The initial slight weight loss gives a short downward section. The curve reaches a minimum above zero. It then turns upwards and becomes steeper as the rate of weight gain increases.

spec.description: Smooth trough entirely above the time axis, followed by an increasingly steep rise; unscaled arrowed axes.
spec.mathematics: Positive weight initially decreases slightly, reaches a minimum, then increases at an increasing rate.

children.label: f
children.prompt: When radioactive material decays, the amount of material present decreases at a decreasing rate.

answer.short: A decreasing curve from a positive mass that becomes less steep and approaches zero; horizontal axis Time, vertical axis Mass.
answer.worked: Start with a positive mass. The mass decreases, so the curve slopes downwards. The decreasing rate of loss makes the curve progressively flatter while it remains above zero.

spec.description: Decreasing concave-up curve remains above the time axis and approaches it; axes have arrows but no numerical scale.
spec.mathematics: Positive mass decreases at a decreasing rate towards zero.

children.label: g
children.prompt: When a passenger liner travelling at 20 knots turns off its motor, the speed of the ship decreases at a decreasing rate.

answer.short: A decreasing curve starting at 20 knots and becoming less steep; horizontal axis Time, vertical axis Speed (knots).
answer.worked: At the moment the motor is turned off, the speed is 20 knots. The speed falls rapidly at first, giving a steep negative gradient. The curve then becomes less steep as the rate of decrease becomes smaller.

spec.description: Initial speed annotated 20 at the vertical intercept; decreasing concave-up curve flattens above the time axis. No additional numeric ticks.
spec.mathematics: Initial speed 20 knots; speed decreases at a decreasing rate. Drawing coordinates do not add a numerical time scale.

children.label: h
children.prompt: The amount of interest earned increases at an increasing rate when money is invested at a compounding interest rate.

answer.short: An increasing curve that becomes steeper; horizontal axis Time, vertical axis Interest.
answer.worked: Interest increases, so the graph rises. An increasing rate of increase gives a progressively steeper curve. The supplied graph starts with a small positive amount of interest; if time starts at the initial investment, accumulated interest instead starts at zero.

spec.description: Preserves the supplied low positive vertical intercept and increasingly steep rising curve. The prompt does not specify the time origin.
spec.mathematics: Interest increases at an increasing rate. Positive initial interest follows the supplied response rather than an inferred investment-start time.
